title: Privacy Policy
description: Tokenization 2050 privacy policy — how we handle your data.
body:
# Privacy Policy

*Last updated: 17 November 2026*

Tokenization 2050 is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle data when you visit our website.

## Data We Collect

**We collect no personal data by default.** This website:

- Does not use cookies
- Does not use tracking pixels or analytics scripts
- Does not use third-party advertising
- Does not fingerprint your browser

## Newsletter

If you voluntarily subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address solely for the purpose of sending you editorial content. You may unsubscribe at any time using the link in every newsletter.

We do not sell, rent, or share your email address with third parties.

## Server Logs

Our hosting provider (GitHub Pages) may collect standard server logs including IP addresses, browser type, and pages visited. These logs are managed by GitHub in accordance with their [privacy policy](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). We do not access or process these logs.

## External Links

Our articles contain links to external websites (sources, referenced companies, regulators). These sites have their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for their data practices.

## Social Media Links

The social media buttons on this site (WhatsApp and our other channels) are plain links. We do not embed social media widgets, "like" buttons or scripts, so nothing is loaded from those platforms and they receive no data about your visit until you click a link. Once you are on their site, their own privacy policies apply.

## RSS and JSON Feeds

Our RSS and JSON feeds are publicly accessible and do not collect any user data.

## Your Rights

Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:

- Access any personal data we hold about you
- Request correction or deletion of your data
- Object to processing of your data
- Request data portability

Since we collect minimal data, these rights primarily apply to newsletter subscribers.

## Contact

For privacy-related enquiries:

**Email**: [{{CONTACT_EMAIL}}](mailto:{{CONTACT_EMAIL}})

## Changes

We may update this privacy policy. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.
